tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: a soft near-black, not pure black (Supabase Studio dark --background, oklch(0.19)).

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the setup rail. Dark: one quiet step above bg (Supabase Studio dark --background-surface-100 / card).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised rows, hover, table headers, inputs. Dark: Supabase Studio dark --background-surface-300.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and rows. Borders, not shadows, separate surfaces. Dark: dim, Supabase Studio dark --border (foreground at 7.5%).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines (secondary button, inputs) — 3:1 on bg and surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Translucent foreground wash for the selected sidebar item and its pressed state; half of it (color-mix 50% with transparent) is the hover. Supabase Studio --sidebar-accent = --background-selection = --accent: foreground at alpha elevation-step / tone-span × 1.5 (≈4.9% dark). Composites over any surface.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Checkbox and small-field outlines: Supabase Studio --border-control = --input (foreground at 3% + 38% × contrast-border²). Decorative weight, as in Studio; inputs that must meet 3:1 use border-strong.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: Supabase Studio --ring (primary-bright at 55%), here accent-ink at 55%. Drawn 2px wide, 2px off the element, with a bg-coloured gap (focus-ring), or as a 2px inset outline (focus-inset).

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the background dot grid. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface-1 and surface-2. Dark: soft off-white, Supabase Studio dark --foreground (oklch 0.95), never pure white.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Nav and menu text at rest, closed facet titles, the Only button: Supabase Studio --foreground-light (= --muted-foreground, level 0.8 between surface and foreground). Between ink and ink-muted; ≥4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis labels — ≥4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and surface-2. Dark: Supabase Studio dark --foreground-lighter.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lens indigo. Primary button fill, selected options, the current step and the APILens mark. One solid fill per view region, never a gradient. Dark: a deeper, less saturated plate in the manner of Supabase's --primary-solid; on-accent text on it is ≥4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text, links, focus rings and thin strokes. ≥4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or error-fill plate (≥4.5:1). Dark: the same soft off-white as ink.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, connected, done. A green distinct from the indigo accent, so good news never reads as a link or a selection; problems use amber and red. Healthy items in lists stay grey. 4.5:1 or better on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and ok-soft in both themes. Dark: desaturated.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded / slow / 4xx spikes. Text-safe (≥4.5:1). Dark: desaturated amber.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Down / 5xx / failed checks, as text and icons (≥4.5:1). Never decorative. Dark: desaturated red.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral data series (p50, throughput) and heads-up notes. A quiet slate in dark mode and a soft blue in light, so it never competes with status.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The soft companion of accent: selected choices, focus halos, the active nav item and newly added items.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind ok text and checkmarks: healthy, active, passed.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind warn text.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind error text.

tokens.name: error-tint
tokens.usage: A faint wash on a whole row that failed (5xx in the request log). Fainter than error-soft, so ink, ink-muted and badges on it keep their contrast.

tokens.name: error-fill
tokens.usage: Solid plate of a destructive button, with on-accent text on it (≥4.5:1). Dark: Supabase Studio dark --destructive, deeper than error text.

tokens.name: chart-neutral
tokens.usage: Chart series for the healthy share (2xx, p50, bytes in, returning). ≥3:1 on bg and surface-1. Light: ink-muted.

tokens.name: chart-accent
tokens.usage: Chart lines, sparklines and the highlighted series (p95, bytes out, new). ≥3:1 on bg and surface-1. Dark: a muted indigo; light: accent.

tokens.name: chart-warn
tokens.usage: Chart series for 4xx and other warnings. ≥3:1 on bg and surface-1. Dark: a quieter amber than warn text; light: warn.

tokens.name: chart-error
tokens.usage: Chart series for 5xx and failures. ≥3:1 on bg and surface-1. Dark: Supabase Studio dark chart-status-destructive (--destructive); light: error.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: The quiet grey of a healthy level: the 2xx swatch in Explore's Status facet. Supabase Studio --chart-muted (packages/config/css/charts.css: dark --color-scale-800 hsl(0 0% 31.2%), light --color-scale-700 hsl(207 11.1% 85.9%)), which getLevelColor('success') paints so success recedes and problems stand out. Decorative only, always next to its 2xx text.

tokens.name: env-gray
tokens.usage: Environment dot "gray" (the API's fixed palette, projects.Colors). Dark: the same hue, desaturated.

tokens.name: env-red
tokens.usage: Environment dot "red" (the API's fixed palette, projects.Colors). Dark: the same hue, desaturated.

tokens.name: env-orange
tokens.usage: Environment dot "orange" (the API's fixed palette, projects.Colors). Dark: the same hue, desaturated.

tokens.name: env-yellow
tokens.usage: Environment dot "yellow" (the API's fixed palette, projects.Colors). Dark: the same hue, desaturated.

tokens.name: env-green
tokens.usage: Environment dot "green" (the API's fixed palette, projects.Colors). Dark: the same hue, desaturated.

tokens.name: env-teal
tokens.usage: Environment dot "teal" (the API's fixed palette, projects.Colors). Dark: the same hue, desaturated.

tokens.name: env-blue
tokens.usage: Environment dot "blue" (the API's fixed palette, projects.Colors). Dark: the same hue, desaturated.

tokens.name: env-purple
tokens.usage: Environment dot "purple" (the API's fixed palette, projects.Colors). Dark: the same hue, desaturated.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Page titles in setup and settings.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a page title, ≤ 60ch, ink-muted.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: KPI values. Numbers are always mono so digits don't jump as they update.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside badges and button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, small card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), grid gutters in the dashboard.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default), gaps between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between a headline block and its CTAs.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a page title block and the content below it.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Outer padding on full-page layouts.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Supabase Studio rounded-sm (--radius-sm: 0.333rem, apps/studio/styles/globals.css:18): checkboxes, Explore facet lists and their search field.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small inputs, chart tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, KPI cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and option cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: Only on floating panels (⌘K switcher, popovers). Everything else uses borders.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter around every page, inside the content pane (16px under 860px).

tokens.name: stack-gap
tokens.usage: Title row to view tabs or toolbar, toolbar to content.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Padding inside a card.

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid or stack.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the range picker and nav rows: Supabase Studio's rounded-md (--radius-md: 0.5rem, apps/studio/styles/globals.css:19).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of every page toolbar control.

tokens.name: page-narrow
tokens.usage: The widest a narrow page (settings, forms, Access) gets.

tokens.name: section-menu-w
tokens.usage: The secondary sidebar (section menu) by default; resizable up to 512px.
